analogy.rationale: Cytochrome P450 inhibitors act on metabolic enzymes rather than a signaling pathway, so they produce little transcriptional response in these cells; the closest analogs are other classes sharing CYP-related targets (PTGS1/cyclooxygenase, SLCO1A2/P-glycoprotein) or nuclear receptors (NR3C1, NR3C2, CAR) that are poorly expressed or only indirectly affected.
